title: incident-bot: oncall diagnostics workflow enhancements
author: Priya Raman
description: Motivation: On-call responders repeatedly ask for quicker, higher-signal diagnostics when an SLO alert fires. This PR enhances the incident-bot automated diagnostics workflow to provide prioritized runbook links, condensed telemetry snippets, and a guided triage checklist so on-call engineers can resolve incidents faster. Highlights: 1) new WorkflowManager that orchestrates diagnostic steps and prioritizes runbook links by SLO impact and recent changes; 2) compact runbook rendering for chat and UI (first-class support for 'quick actions'); 3) added telemetry summary snippets (top 3 traces, recent error samples, recent deploy info) that are safely redacted; 4) heuristic scoring for suggested remediation actions tied to SLO-toolkit hints; 5) feature flag gating (oncall_autodiag_v2) and gradual rollout plan. This is a user-facing automation change: tests and safety checks included. Checklist: [x] implement WorkflowManager and scoring; [x] compact runbook renderer; [x] telemetry snippets with redaction; [x] unit and e2e tests; [x] feature flag and rollout plan; [x] docs and release notes. Backwards compatibility: existing runbook links and the previous diagnostics flow remain available behind the feature flag. Rollout: enable for internal SRE + 10% of customers for 48h, monitor error rate and false-positive remediation suggestions, then promote. Rollback: disable feature flag and revert last config change. Related: ENG-1842 (autodiag perf), SRE-592 (oncall feedback).
